tags.definition: Alleged angikar practice, or an attempt to draw someone into it.
Alleged stepwise targeting, isolation, or conditioning of a person toward sexual or angikar activity.
Alleged threats to expose, coerce, or control someone, including with a recording or a secret.
Alleged forced or non-consensual sexual intercourse.
Alleged sexual or other serious abuse of a child or minor.
Alleged pressure, trapping, or forced participation, other than blackmail.
Alleged sexual acts, advances, or exploitation that are not already tagged as rape or minor abuse.
The accused is alleged to be a Goswami, Balak, Bawa, Bavashri, or similar religious authority.
The accused is alleged to be haveli staff, a mukhiyaji, khavas, dalal, or other associate acting for the haveli.
The accused is alleged to be a satsang elder, a senior Vaishnav, or another lay religious figure.
The accused is alleged to be a relative of the speaker or of the person targeted.
The alleged conduct is said to have taken place in a haveli.
The alleged conduct is said to have taken place on a Vraj yatra or similar pilgrimage.
The alleged conduct is said to have taken place in a satsang or similar gathering.
The alleged conduct is said to have taken place in a private home.
Police or authorities are alleged to have refused or failed to take a complaint or file an FIR.
Alleged pressure to stay quiet, disbelieve those who speak, delete evidence, or punish disclosure.
Alleged pressure from followers, family, or the community to accept, comply, or not object.
The speaker describes what they say happened to them.
The speaker describes what they say they saw or heard happen to someone else.
The speaker reports what they were told by others.
The record includes a recorded call, such as with police or a person who is accused.
Alleged murder, killing, or a death caused by the misconduct.
Alleged rape or forced sex by two or more perpetrators.
Alleged rape or forced sex by a single perpetrator; not used when gang_rape applies.
Alleged sexual abuse or sexual targeting of a child or minor; may co-occur with rape flags.
Alleged group sex framed as satsang, ritual, or kotadi-style gathering.
Alleged use of drugs, drink, or intoxication to enable abuse.
Alleged HIV or other STD risk, or forced pregnancy or abortion, tied to the misconduct.
Alleged blackmail, extortion, or threats used to coerce, expose, or silence someone.
Alleged stepwise targeting, isolation, or conditioning of a person by one individual toward sexual or angikar activity.
Alleged grooming or pressure involving family members or a community toward sexual or angikar activity.
Alleged sexual misconduct that is not rape, gang rape, child sexual abuse, or a group sexual ritual.
Alleged angikar practice, or an attempt to draw someone into it.
Alleged black magic, tantra, vashikaran, or similar occult or superstitious practice tied to the harm.
Alleged police or official refusal to act, victim silencing, or community pressure to hide the conduct.
The speaker is giving a direct, first-hand account of what they say happened to them or what they themselves saw or heard.
